lines: a fictional campaign on Guerrilla.Abel, one engine run, 12949 s of game time (Day 1, 07:30 to 11:05)

occupier-forces at f197544 (round 3.5: 06414a4, 0c43877, 1ae2dc9), built in build/agent2-rwdi, on the Remaster shadow of2, stock Guerrilla.Abel (poolStart 60). Every occupier decision is the engine's own; no director key was tuned.

Levers (resistance side only): companions off and the legacy script QRF parked; the player invulnerable in the north-west hills; each captured point set to garrison 0 and support 55 and taken by two to four invulnerable fighters (Le Port four and Arudy three stay to the end); the Outpost and Airfield hold squads deleted; Le Port heat raised once to 60 and one jet strike forced by the test lever; spent cells removed with deleteGroup, the Houdan, Dourdan and Chapoi cells with deleteVehicle only; time x8, x4 while a force is live; the last 50 minutes free. One tri run, --retries 0 -j1, strict mode, 2090 s wall.
cards.voice: Operation Grey Orchard: one engine run on the stock Abel campaign, after round three and a half. The script plays only the resistance; every occupier move is the engine's own.

cues.text: A cell takes Houdan and leaves. Its empty group is outside the budget, and a minute later the zone tick releases it.
cues.line: [15 s] CounterAttack: Village rose; the occupier does not answer (chance 0.40, 0 town(s) taken before)   [79 s] [gmsim] released 1 empty group(s) idle over 60s with no members and no links (east 0 west 0 guer 1 civ 0); 1 since mission start

cues.text: Four fighters take Le Port and stay. The second town wakes the director.
cues.line: [201 s] OccupierForces: AWAKE after 2 distinct towns (Le Port the latest), 2 token(s)

cues.text: It buys a truck with a tank escort, and the launch line now names the escort.
cues.line: [241 s] OccupierForces: [op 1] Motorized squad (4, Ural) with T72 from Le Port Harbour to Le Port (25 unit(s), the pool pays 21, lethality 17.00 of 14.40, 4 fighter(s) reported, road 74 s)

cues.text: The column arrives at defended Le Port and is born whole, in its hull, five point seven kilometres from the player.
cues.line: [315 s] CounterAttack: 4 soldier(s) from Le Port Harbour appear at [8275, 3397], 5716 m from the player (reason: route point, 62% along 739 m of road) in a hull; they march on Le Port

cues.text: The truck stops two hundred and forty metres out and the squad dismounts. The tank drives on to the edge and supports. Repelled.
cues.line: [352 s] CounterAttack: the force on Le Port reached the town edge (244 m out) and dismounts; it moves in   [543 s] OccupierForces: [op 1] Repelled at Le Port: 4 lost, 0 going home; Le Port rests 1800 s, heat +15

cues.text: The Outpost is raided and emptied. Walking takes fifty-five minutes, so a helicopter retakes it.
cues.line: [841 s] OccupierForces: [op 3] arrival rule (forcesSlowEta): the cheapest, FOOT, needs road 3324 s; TRANSPORT_HELI goes, line 51 s

cues.text: Dourdan and Chapoi fall in one tick, counted two and three. Both cells leave their groups behind; the two are released a minute later.
cues.line: [940 s] CounterAttack: Chapoi rose; the occupier director takes it (2 town(s) taken before)   [1005 s] [gmsim] released 2 empty group(s) idle over 60s with no members and no links (east 0 west 0 guer 2 civ 0); 3 since mission start

cues.text: Three fighters hold Arudy for the rest of the run. A BMP comes, born in its hull, and is repelled.
cues.line: [2043 s] OccupierForces: [op 5] APC (4, BMP) from Outpost to Arudy (15 unit(s), the pool pays 11, lethality 11.00 of 10.80, 3 fighter(s) reported, road 256 s)   [2501 s] OccupierForces: [op 5] Repelled at Arudy: 4 lost, 0 going home; Arudy rests 1800 s, heat +15

cues.text: Le Port's rest ends with its fighters still reported. In video four such a town dropped out of reach; now it is re-armed and attacked with the next token.
cues.line: [2343 s] OccupierForces: Le Port rested with 4 fighter(s) reported: re-armed, heat held at 40 until an operation goes (forcesRearmHeat)   [2643 s] OccupierForces: [op 6] Motorized squad (4, Ural) with T72 from Le Port Harbour to Le Port (25 unit(s), the pool pays 21, lethality 17.00 of 14.40, 4 fighter(s) reported, road 74 s)

cues.text: The Airfield's hold squad is deleted too. The capture script still holds its group, so the sweep leaves it alone.
cues.line: [2529 s] scenario note: lever: the Airfield hold squad (3) is deleted; the raiders leave: the base is empty; the director's sightings at the Airfield: 0

cues.text: Raiders empty the Airfield, control falls to sixty-nine percent, and wave one is called.
cues.line: [2643 s] OccupierForces: Wave 1 (30) inbound to Le Port Harbour, control 0.69 (control threshold; lands in 600 s)

cues.text: Its strikes keep the minimal package: six men march on the headquarters, forty minutes by road, and Arudy repels nine more, its second repel.
cues.line: [3244 s] OccupierForces: [op 7] Wave 1 strike: HQ assault (foot 6) from Le Port Harbour on Camp (6 unit(s), the pool pays 0 and stages the infantry, lethality 6.00 of 0.00, 0 fighter(s) reported, road 2450 s)   [3975 s] OccupierForces: [op 8] Repelled at Arudy: 9 lost, 0 going home; Arudy rests 1800 s, heat +15

cues.text: A push-out on the empty Airfield would walk eighty-six minutes; push-outs now take the arrival rule, so it flies.
cues.line: [3844 s] OccupierForces: [op 10] arrival rule (forcesAirEta): the cheapest, FOOT, needs road 5157 s; TRANSPORT_HELI goes, line 117 s

cues.text: The six reach the empty headquarters and it falls. The settled line now says where they went: four to the pool, two dropped.
cues.line: [5709 s] OccupierForces: HQ at Camp destroyed (epoch 1); cache emptied, 0 garaged vehicle(s) wrecked   [5710 s] OccupierForces: [op 7] HQ assault done: 4 back to the pool, 2 dropped (every base full)

cues.text: Arudy's rest ends in the same minute. Re-armed, and the third attack leaves in the same tick.
cues.line: [5767 s] OccupierForces: Arudy rested with 3 fighter(s) reported: re-armed, heat held at 40 until an operation goes (forcesRearmHeat)   [5767 s] OccupierForces: [op 12] APC (4, BMP) from Outpost to Arudy (15 unit(s), the pool pays 11, lethality 11.00 of 10.80, 3 fighter(s) reported, road 256 s)

cues.text: One attacker lives on, forty-seven metres from the centre, for eighteen minutes, until the live timeout ends the operation.
cues.line: [7276 s] OccupierForces: [op 12] Repelled at Arudy: 3 lost, 1 going home; Arudy rests 1800 s, heat +15

cues.text: Le Port is made urgent and gets two BMPs. A jet or a helicopter on top would leave the pool below strong, so the director buys no strike.
cues.line: [8409 s] OccupierForces: no strike with the operation on Le Port: a strike would take the pool below STRONG (pool 41 of 60)

cues.text: Both BMPs drive to the edge, and the escort supports from there.
cues.line: [8526 s] CounterAttack: the force on Le Port reached the town edge (242 m out) and dismounts; it moves in

cues.text: The test lever forces the jet anyway, exempt from the rule. The pool falls to twenty-nine for thirty-seven seconds.
cues.line: [9427 s] OccupierForces: [op 16] Jet strike over Le Port (town, Su25) from Airfield (the pool pays 23, 4 fighter(s) reported, at the reported fighters), urgent   [9427 s] OccupierForces: band STRONG -> STRETCHED (pool 29 of 60)

cues.text: The cell rises at three points. Two helicopters retake the Outpost and Houdan at twelve units each, and the pool dips to stretched for a hundred seconds.
cues.line: [9670 s] OccupierForces: band STRONG -> STRETCHED (pool 31 of 60)

cues.text: Then fifty minutes with no levers. A push-out walks to Dourdan, eleven minutes, under the fifteen-minute rule.
cues.line: [10270 s] OccupierForces: [op 19] Push-out: foot squad (4) from Outpost to Dourdan (4 unit(s), the pool pays 0, lethality 5.00 of 0.00, 0 fighter(s) reported, road 652 s)

cues.text: Every rest that ends on a reported town is re-armed and attacked within one token interval. Between attacks both towns rest and nothing is quiet, so no token waits on a candidate.
cues.line: [10330 s] OccupierForces: Le Port rested with 4 fighter(s) reported: re-armed, heat held at 40 until an operation goes (forcesRearmHeat)   [10871 s] OccupierForces: [op 20] Motorized squad (4, Ural) with T72 from Le Port Harbour to Le Port (25 unit(s), the pool pays 21, lethality 18.25 of 14.40, 4 fighter(s) reported, road 74 s)

cues.text: On the left, the census: live AI never passes forty-six of a hundred and thirty, no spawn waits on the budget, and frames stay near eleven milliseconds.
cues.line: [11020 s] OccupierForces: [op 20] Repelled at Le Port: 4 lost, 0 going home; Le Port rests 1800 s, heat +15

cues.text: Arudy's fifth attack goes as its rest ends. Five operations, five repels: the director never stopped coming.
cues.line: [12949 s] scenario note: end: pool 60 of 60, band STRONG, tokens 0, operation counter 22, waves fired 1, control 0.942857, operations on Arudy [5,8,12,15,21] (repelled 5)

No finding contradicts OCCUPIER-FORCES.md or the contract: no director or engine WARN or ERRR, no operation stuck past the live timeout, no idling while STRONG with a candidate. The loop can stop; the remaining items are tuning.
outro_voice: No director warning, no engine error, no strict check, and the census never passed forty-six of a hundred and thirty. Every re-armed town was attacked within one token interval. Nothing in this run contradicts the design: the loop can stop.
